delivery_fulfillment.next_action: Verify authoritative payment to durable entitlement to usable paid lesson end-to-end.

owner_attention.next_action: Measure routine owner touches and surface only consequential exceptions.

rule: This profile records adoption targets, not operational evidence. Unknown remains unknown until current runtime/business evidence exists.
